theme: Skia m119 and wider GPU support
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.0 adds Direct3D on Windows and broadens Linux architecture support on the Skia m119 engine.
highlights_body: Windows ARM gains OpenGL, tvOS gains SKMetalView, and Android libraries support 16 KB pages. New save-layer and color-filter APIs accompany fixes for WebAssembly, legacy .NET packaging, and image creation.

bullets.detail: Advances through the m117 and m118 previews to Skia m119, with updated GPU context bindings and a new color type.

Adds Direct3D bindings and native support on Windows, enables OpenGL on Windows ARM, and adds tvOS SKMetalView. Metal render-target APIs are available across platforms, and iOS Simulator Metal performance is improved.

bullets.lead: Linux architectures and Android page sizes
bullets.detail: Adds RISC-V 64-bit and LoongArch64 native build support, extends Alpine cross-compilation, and broadens Linux coverage using Debian 10. Android native libraries move to NDK r27c with 16 KB alignment.
Exposes SkCanvas SaveLayerRec through the managed API and adds missing SKColorFilter types.
Fixes .NET 9 Blazor behavior and base-path imports, and applies the WASM workaround even when applications do not use Blazor views.

bullets.lead: Legacy project restore and picture images
bullets.detail: Restores .NET Framework and Mono projects using packages.config, corrects native package path metadata, and fixes SKImage.FromPicture.
Refreshes libpng to 1.6.44, libexpat to 2.6.4, FreeType to a 2.13.3-based revision, and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.2.1, alongside the libjpeg-turbo dependency refresh.

preview_summaries.v3.118.0-preview.1.2: Updated the engine to Skia m118 and refreshed the HarfBuzz dependency to 8.3.1.
preview_summaries.v3.118.0-preview.2.3: Improved .NET 9 WebAssembly compatibility and base-path imports, exposed Metal render-target APIs across platforms, and refreshed native dependencies.
preview_summaries.v3.119.0-preview.1.2: Moved to Skia m119 with Windows Direct3D, Windows ARM OpenGL, tvOS Metal views, and broader Linux architecture coverage. Added Android 16 KB alignment and repaired packages.config support.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp native assets gain RISC-V and LoongArch64 support and Android 16 KB alignment. Package-path and WASM integration fixes are included; the 8.3.1.1 package revision does not imply a new HarfBuzz engine.
